title: Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Headphones
short_description: Industry-leading noise cancelling over-ear headphones with 30-hour battery.
detailed_description: The Sony WH-1000XM5 sets the benchmark for noise-cancelling headphones with eight microphones and two processors for unparalleled ANC. Bluetooth 5.2 and multipoint connection let you switch between two devices seamlessly. Foldable design and a 30-hour battery make it perfect for long commutes and travel.

title: Bose QuietComfort 45 Headphones
short_description: Premium over-ear headphones with world-class noise cancellation and 24-hour battery.
detailed_description: Bose QuietComfort 45 delivers legendary noise cancellation with a comfortable, lightweight design built for all-day wear. Quiet Mode blocks noise and distractions while Aware Mode lets in your surroundings. SimpleSync technology pairs with other Bose devices effortlessly.

title: JBL Tune 770NC Wireless Headphones
short_description: Adaptive noise cancelling headphones with 70-hour mega battery life.
detailed_description: JBL Tune 770NC features Adaptive Noise Cancelling that automatically adjusts to your environment for the best listening experience. With an extraordinary 70-hour battery life and JBL Pure Bass Sound, this headphone is built for music lovers on the go. Foldable and available in multiple bold colors.

title: Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra Smartphone
short_description: Flagship Android smartphone with 200MP camera and built-in S Pen.
detailed_description: The Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra is the ultimate Android powerhouse with a 200MP quad-camera system, built-in S Pen, and Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 processor. The 6.8-inch Dynamic AMOLED display runs at 120Hz for buttery-smooth visuals. A 5000mAh battery with 45W fast charging keeps you powered all day.

title: Apple iPhone 15 Pro Smartphone
short_description: Apple's most advanced iPhone with titanium design and A17 Pro chip.
detailed_description: iPhone 15 Pro features a lightweight titanium frame with a 48MP main camera, 5x optical zoom telephoto, and the A17 Pro chip for unprecedented performance. The Action Button is fully customisable, and USB 3 speeds enable fast data transfer and ProRes video recording directly to external storage.

title: OnePlus 12 5G Smartphone
short_description: Flagship killer with Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 and 100W SUPERVOOC charging.
detailed_description: The OnePlus 12 packs the Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 chipset with up to 16GB RAM and 512GB storage for elite performance. The Hasselblad-tuned triple camera system delivers professional-grade photography. 100W SUPERVOOC wired charging fills the 5400mAh battery from zero to full in just 26 minutes.

title: Apple MacBook Air M3 Laptop
short_description: Ultra-thin laptop powered by Apple M3 chip with 18-hour battery life.
detailed_description: The MacBook Air M3 is Apple's thinnest and lightest laptop featuring the breakthrough M3 chip for up to 60% faster performance than M1. The 13.6-inch Liquid Retina display is stunning, and with up to 18 hours of battery life you can work all day without a charger. Available in four beautiful finishes.

title: Dell XPS 15 Laptop
short_description: 15.6-inch OLED powerhouse laptop for creators and professionals.
detailed_description: The Dell XPS 15 features a stunning 15.6-inch 3.5K OLED touch display with 100% DCI-P3 colour coverage, ideal for content creators. Powered by an Intel Core i7-13700H and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060, it handles video editing and 3D rendering with ease. A 86Whr battery and sleek CNC aluminium chassis round out the premium package.

title: Sony Alpha ZV-E10 Mirrorless Camera
short_description: APS-C mirrorless vlogging camera with interchangeable lens system.
detailed_description: The Sony ZV-E10 is a compact interchangeable-lens camera designed for vloggers and content creators. Its 24.2MP APS-C sensor delivers crisp, cinematic footage in 4K, while the side-flip LCD screen makes solo filming effortless. Real-time eye autofocus and a built-in directional 3-capsule microphone ensure professional results every time.

title: JBL Charge 5 Portable Bluetooth Speaker
short_description: Waterproof portable speaker with 20-hour playtime and power bank feature.
detailed_description: The JBL Charge 5 delivers bold JBL Pro Sound in a rugged IP67 waterproof and dustproof design. With 20 hours of playtime and a built-in power bank to charge your devices, it's the ultimate outdoor companion. PartyBoost lets you pair two compatible JBL speakers for stereo sound.

title: Apple Watch Series 9 Smartwatch
short_description: The most powerful Apple Watch with S9 chip, double tap gesture, and always-on display.
detailed_description: Apple Watch Series 9 introduces the S9 chip for faster on-device Siri, a new double tap gesture, and a brighter always-on Retina display. Advanced health sensors track blood oxygen, ECG, temperature, and crash detection. With 18-hour battery life and water resistance to 50 metres, it keeps pace with your day.

title: Anker 65W USB-C GaN Charger
short_description: Compact 3-port GaN charger powering laptops, phones, and tablets simultaneously.
detailed_description: Anker's 65W GaN charger uses next-gen gallium nitride technology to pack laptop-level power into a charger smaller than a deck of cards. Two USB-C and one USB-A port allow you to charge three devices at once with intelligent power distribution. PowerIQ 3.0 detects each device and delivers the optimal charge speed.

title: Nike Dri-FIT Men's Running T-Shirt
short_description: Lightweight, sweat-wicking men's tee engineered for performance.
detailed_description: The Nike Dri-FIT technology moves sweat away from your skin to help keep you dry and comfortable during workouts. Made from 100% recycled polyester, this running tee features a relaxed fit and ventilation panels for breathability. Reflective details enhance visibility in low-light conditions.

title: Levi's 511 Slim Fit Men's Jeans
short_description: Classic slim-fit jeans with just enough stretch for all-day comfort.
detailed_description: Levi's 511 Slim Fit jeans sit below the waist and fit slim through the thigh and leg opening. The signature flex fabric gives you the freedom to move without losing that sharp silhouette. A versatile wardrobe staple available in a range of classic washes.

title: Zara Floral Wrap Midi Dress
short_description: Elegant floral wrap dress with a flattering midi length for any occasion.
detailed_description: This Zara wrap dress features a vibrant floral print on a fluid satin-feel fabric that drapes beautifully. The adjustable tie waist creates a universally flattering silhouette, while the midi length makes it appropriate for both casual outings and semi-formal events. Available in bold floral colourways.

title: H&M Oversized Blazer Women
short_description: Structured oversized blazer in a relaxed fit for a polished, modern look.
detailed_description: This H&M oversized blazer is cut from a woven fabric with a slight stretch for all-day comfort. Padded shoulders, notched lapels, and a single-button closure create a sharp silhouette that works equally well over a turtleneck or a slip dress. A timeless investment piece for any wardrobe.

title: Nike Air Max 270 Sneakers
short_description: Lifestyle sneakers with Nike's largest Air unit for all-day cushioning.
detailed_description: The Nike Air Max 270 draws design inspiration from Air Max icons of the past. The Air unit in the heel — Nike's largest ever in a lifestyle shoe — delivers an exceptional underfoot feel. The breathable mesh upper keeps your feet cool, while the foam midsole provides a plush, stable ride.

title: Adidas Stan Smith Leather Sneakers
short_description: Iconic minimalist leather tennis sneaker — a timeless style staple.
detailed_description: The Adidas Stan Smith has been a fashion icon since the 1970s. Crafted from smooth full-grain leather with a clean low-profile silhouette, these sneakers pair effortlessly with everything from jeans to suits. The perforated 3-Stripes and OrthoLite cushioned insole ensure comfort all day long.

title: Fossil Leather Crossbody Bag
short_description: Compact genuine leather crossbody bag with multiple pockets for everyday use.
detailed_description: This Fossil crossbody bag is crafted from full-grain leather that develops a rich patina over time. The adjustable strap, zip-top closure, and three interior pockets keep your essentials organised and secure. Compact enough for daily errands, refined enough for a night out.

title: Casio G-Shock GA-2100 Watch
short_description: Slim, rugged analogue-digital watch with carbon core guard structure.
detailed_description: The Casio G-Shock GA-2100 features an ultra-slim carbon core guard structure that reduces weight while maintaining legendary G-Shock toughness. With shock resistance, 200m water resistance, and a minimalist octagonal bezel, it bridges the gap between sporty and fashion-forward. Battery life of approximately 3 years.

title: Ray-Ban Wayfarer Classic Sunglasses
short_description: Timeless Wayfarer frame with 100% UV protection — an eternal style icon.
detailed_description: The Ray-Ban Wayfarer is the best-selling sunglasses style in the world, worn by icons from James Dean to Lady Gaga. The acetate frame is lightweight yet durable, and the G-15 crystal lenses offer excellent colour contrast with 100% UV protection. A perfect balance of style and function since 1956.

title: IKEA VARDAGEN Cast Iron Skillet
short_description: Pre-seasoned cast iron skillet for even heat distribution and superior browning.
detailed_description: The IKEA VARDAGEN cast iron skillet retains heat exceptionally well for restaurant-quality searing, frying, and baking. It comes pre-seasoned and becomes more non-stick with every use. Compatible with all hob types including induction, and safe in ovens up to 260°C.

title: Instant Pot Duo 7-in-1 Pressure Cooker
short_description: Multi-function electric pressure cooker that replaces 7 kitchen appliances.
detailed_description: The Instant Pot Duo combines a pressure cooker, slow cooker, rice cooker, steamer, sauté pan, yogurt maker, and food warmer in one appliance. With 14 smart programmes and a 5.7-litre capacity, it cuts cooking time by up to 70%. The UL-certified lid locks safely for worry-free pressure cooking.

title: Wakefit Orthopedic Memory Foam Mattress
short_description: Dual-layer memory foam mattress with orthopedic support for pressure relief.
detailed_description: The Wakefit Orthopedic Memory Foam Mattress features a 7.5cm high-density base foam layer topped with a 2.5cm memory foam comfort layer for optimal spinal alignment. The breathable knitted fabric cover is removable and washable. Suitable for all sleeping positions and backed by a 10-year warranty.

title: IKEA LACK Wall Shelf Unit
short_description: Simple floating wall shelf for displaying books, plants, and décor items.
detailed_description: The IKEA LACK wall shelf is a minimalist floating shelf that adds storage and style to any room. Made from a honeycomb paper construction that is lightweight yet sturdy, it mounts cleanly to walls with concealed fittings. Available in a range of finishes to match your décor.

title: Philips Hue White & Color Ambiance Bulb
short_description: Smart LED bulb with 16 million colours, controllable via app or voice.
detailed_description: The Philips Hue White and Colour Ambiance bulb gives you access to 16 million colours and all shades of white light from warm to cool daylight. Control via the Hue app, voice assistants, or smart home platforms. With up to 25,000 hours of life and 800 lumens, it's a long-lasting smart lighting upgrade.

title: IKEA KALLAX Shelf Unit
short_description: Versatile 4-cube shelf unit that works as a room divider, bookcase, or TV stand.
detailed_description: The IKEA KALLAX is one of the most versatile pieces of furniture you can own. Use it vertically as a bookcase, horizontally as a TV stand, or in multiples as a room divider. The square compartments fit standard storage boxes and baskets perfectly. Assembly is straightforward with the included fitting hardware.

title: Fiskars Garden Pruning Shears
short_description: Precision-ground steel pruning shears with low-friction coating for clean cuts.
detailed_description: Fiskars pruning shears feature a precision-ground, hardened steel blade with a low-friction coating that glides through branches up to 1.6cm thick. The ergonomic handle with SoftGrip coating reduces hand fatigue during extended use. A fully hardened steel blade retains sharpness through thousands of cuts.

title: IKEA MALM 6-Drawer Chest
short_description: Clean-lined 6-drawer chest with smooth-gliding drawers for bedroom storage.
detailed_description: The IKEA MALM 6-drawer chest is a bedroom storage classic with a smooth, white finish and integrated handles for a seamless look. Smooth-running drawers with pull-out stop prevent accidental tipping. Anti-tip safety fittings are included to secure the unit to your wall for added safety.

title: Decathlon Corength Adjustable Dumbbells 20kg
short_description: Space-saving adjustable dumbbell set ranging from 2kg to 20kg per hand.
detailed_description: The Decathlon Corength adjustable dumbbells replace a full rack of weights with a single compact unit. A dial mechanism lets you select your desired weight in seconds without swapping plates. The contoured handle with knurled grip ensures secure hold during intense lifting sessions.

title: Lifelong Resistance Bands Set
short_description: Set of 5 latex resistance bands for strength training, yoga, and physiotherapy.
detailed_description: This Lifelong resistance band set includes 5 bands of varying resistance levels (2kg to 22kg) colour-coded for easy identification. Made from 100% natural latex with double-layer reinforcement for safety and durability. Suitable for upper body, lower body, and full-body workouts at home or in the gym.

title: Columbia Newton Ridge Hiking Boots
short_description: Waterproof leather hiking boots with Omni-Grip traction for rugged terrain.
detailed_description: Columbia's Newton Ridge Plus hiking boots feature a waterproof seam-sealed construction that keeps feet dry on wet trails. The Omni-Grip non-marking traction rubber outsole provides reliable grip on uneven terrain. A lightweight midsole with Techlite cushioning delivers long-lasting comfort mile after mile.

title: Manduka PRO Yoga Mat 6mm
short_description: Professional-grade 6mm yoga mat with lifetime guarantee and superior grip.
detailed_description: The Manduka PRO yoga mat is the gold standard for yoga practitioners worldwide. At 6mm thick it provides outstanding joint cushioning without compromising stability in standing poses. The closed-cell surface seals out sweat and bacteria, and the mat improves grip with use. Backed by a lifetime guarantee.

title: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus 40 Running Shoes
short_description: Responsive everyday running shoe with Air Zoom unit for speed and cushioning.
detailed_description: The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus 40 is a versatile everyday trainer trusted by millions of runners worldwide. A wider Air Zoom unit in the forefoot delivers propulsive responsiveness, while the React foam midsole provides plush cushioning. The engineered mesh upper offers a snug, breathable fit from the first step.

title: Decathlon B'Twin 900 Road Cycling Helmet
short_description: Aerodynamic road cycling helmet with 21 vents and in-mould polycarbonate shell.
detailed_description: The Decathlon B'Twin 900 road helmet features an aerodynamic in-mould polycarbonate shell with 21 strategic vents for optimal airflow. The precision Ergofit retention system ensures a secure, customised fit. Certified to EN1078 safety standard and weighing just 260g, it's built for long-distance road riding.

title: Cetaphil Gentle Skin Cleanser 500ml
short_description: Dermatologist-recommended gentle cleanser for sensitive and dry skin types.
detailed_description: Cetaphil Gentle Skin Cleanser is a non-irritating, soap-free formula that effectively removes dirt, makeup, and impurities without stripping the skin's natural moisture barrier. Recommended by dermatologists for sensitive, dry, and combination skin. Can be used with or without water, making it ideal for on-the-go cleansing.

title: The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Serum
short_description: High-strength niacinamide serum to minimise pores and control sebum.
detailed_description: The Ordinary's Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% is a water-based serum that visibly reduces the appearance of enlarged pores and uneven skin tone. Niacinamide (vitamin B3) supports the skin's moisture barrier, while zinc PCA regulates sebum production for a balanced, matte complexion. Suitable for all skin types.

title: Mamaearth Vitamin C Face Wash 100ml
short_description: Brightening face wash with Vitamin C and Turmeric for a radiant glow.
detailed_description: Mamaearth's Vitamin C Face Wash combines the brightening power of Vitamin C with the anti-inflammatory properties of Turmeric to fade dark spots and give skin a natural glow. The sulphate-free, toxin-free formula gently cleanses without over-drying. Dermatologically tested and made with naturally-derived ingredients.

title: L'Oréal Elvive Extraordinary Oil Shampoo 400ml
short_description: Nourishing shampoo with 6 rare flower oils for silky, luminous hair.
detailed_description: L'Oréal Elvive Extraordinary Oil Shampoo is enriched with a blend of 6 rare flower oils that penetrate deep into dry, coarse hair fibres to nourish from within. Leaves hair feeling silky smooth, lightweight, and luminous from the very first wash. Suitable for all hair types, especially dry and frizzy hair.

title: Dyson Supersonic Hair Dryer
short_description: Intelligent hair dryer with fast drying, heat control, and balanced design.
detailed_description: The Dyson Supersonic uses a small, powerful digital motor in the handle to produce a high-pressure, high-velocity airflow. Intelligent heat control measures temperature 40 times per second to protect hair from extreme heat damage. Magnetic attachments including a diffuser, concentrator, and styling nozzle are included.

title: Muscleblaze Whey Gold Protein 2kg
short_description: Premium whey protein isolate with 25g protein per serving for muscle growth.
detailed_description: MuscleBlaze Whey Gold is a 100% whey protein isolate delivering 25g of protein and 5.5g of BCAAs per serving with minimal fat and carbohydrates. Cold-processed to preserve bioactivity and naturally sweetened for a clean taste. Ideal for post-workout recovery and muscle building.

title: Maybelline Fit Me Matte Foundation
short_description: Buildable matte foundation with pore-minimising formula for a natural finish.
detailed_description: Maybelline Fit Me Matte + Poreless Foundation controls shine and minimises pores for a natural, skin-like matte finish. The micro-powder formula blurs pores and imperfections for up to 12 hours of wear. Available in 40 shades to suit a wide range of skin tones, and oil-free for all skin types.

title: Colgate Sensitive Pro-Relief Toothpaste 110g
short_description: Clinically proven toothpaste that blocks pain for sensitive teeth instantly.
detailed_description: Colgate Sensitive Pro-Relief toothpaste uses Pro-Argin technology to plug exposed dentinal tubules and build a protective layer over sensitive areas. Clinically proven to provide instant and lasting relief from sensitive teeth pain. Provides the same cavity protection as regular fluoride toothpaste with daily use.

title: boAt Airdopes 141 TWS Earbuds
short_description: True wireless earbuds with 42-hour total playtime and BEAST mode for gaming.
detailed_description: boAt Airdopes 141 TWS earbuds deliver IWS (Instacharge Wireless System) that gives 75 minutes of playtime from just 5 minutes of charge. BEAST mode reduces latency for lag-free gaming and video streaming. The IPX4 water-resistant design and 42-hour combined battery make them ideal for active users.

title: Puma Men's Active Woven Trackpants
short_description: Lightweight woven trackpants with side pockets and elastic drawstring waist.
detailed_description: Puma's Active Woven Trackpants are cut from a quick-dry woven fabric that keeps you comfortable during workouts and casual outings alike. Two side pockets and a back zip pocket keep essentials secure. The elastic waistband with internal drawstring provides a customisable fit.

title: WildCraft 45L Hiking Backpack
short_description: 45L trekking backpack with rain cover, hip belt, and multiple compartments.
detailed_description: The Wildcraft 45L Hiking Backpack is engineered for multi-day treks with an ergonomic suspension system, padded shoulder straps, and a load-distributing hip belt. The main compartment, front organiser panel, and hydration sleeve keep gear accessible and organised. Includes a detachable rain cover for sudden downpours.

title: Himalaya Neem Face Wash 150ml
short_description: Purifying neem face wash that controls acne and prevents future breakouts.
detailed_description: Himalaya Purifying Neem Face Wash harnesses the antibacterial and astringent properties of Neem and Turmeric to deep-cleanse pores and control acne-causing bacteria. The gentle, soap-free formula removes excess oil and impurities without drying out the skin. Dermatologically tested for sensitive skin.

title: IKEA POÄNG Armchair
short_description: Classic bentwood layer-glued armchair with cushion for timeless comfort.
detailed_description: The IKEA POÄNG armchair has been a design icon since 1976. Its layer-glued bent birch frame flexes to support every movement, providing ergonomic comfort throughout the day. The removable, washable cushion cover means it's as practical as it is beautiful. A versatile statement piece for any living space.

title: Garmin Forerunner 255 GPS Running Watch
short_description: GPS running watch with advanced training metrics, HRV status, and 14-day battery.
detailed_description: The Garmin Forerunner 255 is a purpose-built running watch with multi-band GPS for accurate pace and distance tracking. Training Readiness and HRV Status guide your workouts, while daily suggested workouts adapt to your fitness level. The lightweight design and 14-day battery life make it a capable everyday training partner.

custom_specifications.health_metrics: HRV Status, VO2 Max, Training Readiness

title: Nivea Men Dark Spot Reduction Cream 50ml
short_description: Men's moisturiser with SPF 15 that reduces dark spots and evens skin tone.
detailed_description: Nivea Men Dark Spot Reduction Cream uses a powerful complex of Vitamin C and Ginkgo Biloba to visibly reduce dark spots and even out skin tone in just 4 weeks. SPF 15 provides daily UV protection to prevent further darkening. The non-greasy, fast-absorbing formula is ideal for the male grooming routine.
